content.text:
I checked six claims in the overview against the record and found nothing to flag. Each one matches a line in the record:

- **The slowdown:** "slowed down for some shoppers" rests on the line about what readers saw, and the record never says which shoppers or how many.
- **The worst-minute failures and the cost in takings:** both come from the list of figures.
- **The likely cause:** the "likely" wording comes from the plain-words cause line.
- **Nobody paged:** this matches the figures line and the record's assumption that no engineer time was spent.
- **The restart:** the restart and its confirmation are in M1, T16 and T19.
- **The draft fix:** the record lists it as opened as a draft and says nothing about it after that.

supported.quote: For {duration}, the io-shop online shop slowed down for some shoppers
rows: What a reader saw: Requests to the shop slowed down

supported.quote: at the worst minute {peak_error_rate} of requests were failing
rows: Requests failing at the worst minute: 4.0% {peak_error_rate}

supported.quote: The cause was likely that the shop's server kept a note of every shopper who visited and never threw any of those notes away, so it used more and more memory the longer it ran.
rows: Why, in plain words: The shop's server likely kept a note of every shopper who visited

supported.quote: Argus estimates the cost to the shop in takings at {customer_loss}
rows: What it cost the shop in takings (estimated by Argus): none {customer_loss}

supported.quote: no one on call was paged to respond
rows: Nobody was paged: no on-call incident was linked to this one.
No engineer minutes: no on-call incident was linked to this one

supported.quote: To end the incident, Argus restarted io-shop, and the restart was confirmed.
Argus has also proposed a fix for the underlying cause, but it is only a draft and has not been put into use yet.
rows: Argus: proposed a fix, PR #531 - opened as a draft
The fix it proposed: PR #531 ... opened as a draft. The record holds nothing about it after that.
